import re

class PHIMaskingGuard:
    """
    S-Class Governed Autonomous Coding Agent - PHI Masking Guard
    Masks SSNs, MRNs, and Emails across clinical notes, handling obfuscated spaces or dots.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        # Pattern for SSN: XXX-XX-XXXX with optional spaces/dots instead of hyphens
        # e.g., 123-45-6789, 123.45.6789, 123 45 6789
        self.ssn_pattern = re.compile(r'\b\d{3}[\s\.-]\d{2}[\s\.-]\d{4}\b')
        
        # Pattern for MRN: MRN-XXXXXX with optional spaces/dots
        # e.g., MRN-123456, MRN.123456, MRN 123456, mrn-123456
        self.mrn_pattern = re.compile(r'\b[Mm][Rr][Nn][\s\.-]\d{1,10}\b')
        
        # Pattern for Emails, handling potential obfuscation (e.g., user [at] domain [dot] com)
        # Standard email or common dot/space obfuscations
        self.email_pattern = re.compile(
            r'\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+\s*[@\[\(](?:\s*at\s*)?[\s\)\]]*\s*[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\s*[\.\[\(](?:\s*dot\s*)?[\s\)\]]*\s*[A-Za-z]{2,}\b',
            re.IGNORECASE
        )

    def mask_phi(self, text: str) -> str:
        """
        Masks SSNs, MRNs, and Emails in the provided clinical text.
        """
        if not isinstance(text, str):
            return text

        # Apply masking sequentially
        masked_text = self.ssn_pattern.sub('[REDACTED_SSN]', text)
        masked_text = self.mrn_pattern.sub('[REDACTED_MRN]', masked_text)
        masked_text = self.email_pattern.sub('[REDACTED_EMAIL]', masked_text)
        
        return masked_text
```
